assets.label: 공정 이력을 손으로 추적하는 현장
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: single square photographic insert for the BEFORE cut of a Korean semiconductor R&D introduction video, 1024x1024 or similar square.
Style: photorealistic candid enterprise R&D photography, realistic skin/hands/materials, elegant black-and-warm-gold visual continuity. Believable modern engineering office or analysis lab, charcoal furnishings, muted warm practical light, restrained amber edge light, subtle monitor light, natural shadows.
Composition: the described work action must remain clearly legible when displayed at 494x500 pixels. One coherent scene, no multi-panel image, no montage. Keep key hands/props within the center 85 percent; no typography required.
Constraints: no captions, no legible text, no letters, no logos, no readable numbers, no watermark, no artificial sci-fi holograms, no giant floating UI, no comic frustration, no repeated generic man with chin on hand. Show normal professional effort before automation. Human figures are fictional representatives, not portraits of project owners.
Primary request: A Korean female process engineer standing beside a transparent planning board, tracing a sequence of process-history cards with a dry-erase marker and glancing back at a laptop with a simple abstract correlation grid. Her narrowed eyes and slightly tilted head express effort to identify which upstream process is relevant. Side profile with the tracing arm prominent. Plain cards connected by a few drawn lines, no legible writing, no chin-rest.
assets.review: PASS: Korean female engineer manually traces connected process-history cards on a transparent board. Focused gaze and marker action replace a generic worried pose. Correlation grid is visible on laptop; hand and arm anatomy are coherent.
assets.review_method: individual view_image visual inspection at original square resolution
